title: Fishing (the Fishing HUD and its Board window)
layout_order: HUD band along the bottom (above the bottom toolbar): LEFT your week (YOUR WEEK score, PLACE, FISH CAUGHT, THE BOARD STARTS AGAIN EVERY MONDAY) | CENTRE state line, then the message area with its scroll bar (or, in a Challenge game, LINE TENSION and LINE IN bars) | RIGHT top row CAST/GET MY ROD, REEL IN; second row STOP, BOARD, CHALLENGE, BACKGROUND, CLOSE; WOLF FISHING logo under them | above the band at the left: the pile TODAY'S CATCH with TIP THEM BACK | size grip on the band's top edge. Board window (wolf_fishing, 500 x 610): logo + status line, Cast / Reel in / Stop fishing, Your week + your biggest fish list, This week's top 10 + Update, board note, last week, Challenge mode check box, Put the rod away

controls.label: CAST / GET MY ROD (no rod)
controls.when: on Wolf, rod not being found, and no rod or the line idle (else drawn dim, no hit)
controls.tip: Cast your line into the water in front of you. Face the water first. / Put your fishing rod in your hand (you get one if you have none)
controls.action: WolfFishingSession::cast() (also gets the rod when there is none)
source: "Put your fishing rod in your hand (you get one if you have none)"
: "Cast your line into the water in front of you. Face the water first.", 16.f,

controls.label: REEL IN (glows green and breathes at a bite; held down in Challenge mode)
controls.when: rod ready and the line out (waiting or a bite)
controls.tip: Reel in your line and see what you have caught. There is no hurry - a fish that bites waits for you. / Challenge mode: hold this down to bring the fish in, and let go before the line goes into the red.
controls.action: WolfFishingSession::reel(); Challenge mode: held = challengeStep(dt, holding)
source: "Challenge mode: hold this down to bring the fish in, and let go before the line goes into the red."
: "Reel in your line and see what you have caught. There is no hurry - a fish that bites waits for you.", 16.f,

controls.label: STOP
controls.when: rod ready and the line out
controls.tip: Take your line out of the water without reeling in
source: "STOP", H_STOP, "Take your line out of the water without reeling in"

controls.label: BOARD
controls.tip: Your week and this week's top 10 on Wolf Territories (the Fishing window)
source: "Your week and this week's top 10 on Wolf Territories (the Fishing window)"

controls.label: CHALLENGE: ON / CHALLENGE: OFF
controls.when: on Wolf Territories; per resident (WolfFishingChallenge), off by default
controls.tip: Challenge mode is on: hold REEL IN and keep the line out of the red. Click to switch it off (one press reels in, no hurry). / Challenge mode is off: one press of REEL IN brings the fish in, no hurry. Click to switch it on: hold REEL IN and keep the line out of the red.
controls.action: WolfFishingSession::setChallenge(!challengeOn()); says the new mode in the message area
source: "Challenge mode is on: hold REEL IN and keep the line out of the red. Click to switch it off (one press reels in, no hurry)."
"Challenge mode is off: one press of REEL IN brings the fish in, no hurry. Click to switch it on: hold REEL IN and keep the line out of the red."
"Challenge mode is on: at a bite, hold REEL IN and let go before the line goes into the red."
"Challenge mode is off: one press of REEL IN brings the fish in, and there is no hurry."

controls.label: BACKGROUND: ON / BACKGROUND: OFF
controls.tip: The night-blue background is on. Click to take it away and see more of the world: just the buttons and words stay. / The background is off. Click to put the night-blue background back behind the HUD.
controls.action: gSavedPerAccountSettings WolfFishingHudBackground flipped (off: words outlined, clicks between controls reach the world)
source: "The night-blue background is on. Click to take it away and see more of the world: just the buttons and words stay."
"The background is off. Click to put the night-blue background back behind the HUD."

controls.label: CLOSE
controls.tip: Close Fishing. Your rod stays in your hand: touch it to fish from its menu (Wolf World > Fishing brings this back).
controls.action: WolfFishingSession::closeAll() (HUD and Board close, the rod gets "bye")
source: "Close Fishing. Your rod stays in your hand: touch it to fish from its menu (Wolf World > Fishing brings this back)."

controls.label: TIP THEM BACK (beside TODAY'S CATCH: n)
controls.when: the pile has something in it
controls.tip: Tip today's catch back into the water (the pile starts again; your week's score stays)
source: "Tip today's catch back into the water (the pile starts again; your week's score stays)"
"You tipped today's catch back into the water."

controls.label: up arrow at the top of the message scroll bar
controls.when: more messages than show, and scrolled back (else drawn dim, no hit)
controls.tip: Newer messages
controls.small_ok: a part of a mechanism (Shadow 25 Nov): the message area's scroll bar, 22 units wide; the mouse wheel over the message area scrolls the same history
source: arrow(upB, upT, true, H_SCROLL_UP, "Newer messages", mScroll > 0);
case H_SCROLL_UP: mScroll = llmax(0, mScroll - 1); break;

controls.label: down arrow at the bottom of the message scroll bar
controls.tip: Older messages
controls.small_ok: a part of a mechanism (Shadow 25 Nov): the message area's scroll bar, 22 units wide; the mouse wheel over the message area scrolls the same history
source: arrow(dnB, dnT, false, H_SCROLL_DOWN, "Older messages", mScroll + shown < mMsgTotal);
case H_SCROLL_DOWN: mScroll = llmin(llmax(0, mMsgTotal - 1), mScroll + 1); break;

controls.label: the scroll bar's track
controls.tip: The message history: drag, click, or use the mouse wheel to scroll back
controls.action: a page up or down toward the click
controls.small_ok: a part of a mechanism (Shadow 25 Nov): the message area's scroll bar, 22 units wide; the mouse wheel over the message area scrolls the same history
source: H_SCROLL_TRACK, "The message history: drag, click, or use the mouse wheel to scroll back"
if (py > mThumbT) mScroll = llmax(0, mScroll - page);
else if (py < mThumbB) mScroll = llmin(llmax(0, mMsgTotal - 1), mScroll + page);

controls.label: the scroll bar's thumb
controls.tip: Drag to scroll through the messages
controls.action: drag: the history follows it (down = older)
controls.small_ok: a part of a mechanism (Shadow 25 Nov): the message area's scroll bar, 22 units wide; the mouse wheel over the message area scrolls the same history
source: H_SCROLL_THUMB, "Drag to scroll through the messages"
mScroll = llclamp(mDragScroll + (S32)llround((mDragY - (F32)y / mHitScale) * per), 0, llmax(0, mMsgTotal - 1));
